blind_target.title: Representative Bureaucracy and the Willingness to Coproduce: An Experimental Study.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study is to conceptually replicate an earlier study by Riccucci, Van Ryzin, and Li (2016), who examined the effects of representative bureaucracy on the public’s willingness to participate with government in recycling.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our experiment, in sum, produced only null findings, in contrast to the original study by Riccucci, Van Ryzin, and Li (2016).
